## Assigned reading

Finish reading these if you haven't yet:

- If you already feel comfortable with R & this isn't your first statistics class:
    - Introduction to Regression Analysis: A Data Science Approach: [Ch 7: Multiple Linear Regression](https://introregression.netlify.app/07-mlr)
- If you're new to R & statistics:
    - Introduction to Modern Statistics (IMS) [Ch 8: Linear regression with multiple predictors](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/model-mlr)
